in_marathi.name: Hirok
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Shining Mountain, Radiant, Brave
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hirok हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। From the Sanskrit word 'Hira' meaning mountain and 'K' meaning shining or radiant, Hirok is a name that symbolizes the strength and courage of a mountain. It is a name that is often given to boys born during a time when the sun is shining brightly, bringing joy and vitality to all around.
